subject: Private Offer: Aurelia Therapeutics - Azure private plan procurement path
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aureliatx.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Malik <samir.malik@aureliatx.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private Offer Request + Procurement path for Azure private plan

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed for long-form summarization. Procurement asked me to send the private-offer paperwork and confirm the steps for an Azure private plan purchase.

Attached: Aurelia_PrivateOffer_20270302.docx and a draft SOW (Aurelia_SOW_v1.pdf). Key asks from our side:
- Confirm entitlement activation process and estimated time-to-provision after PO/DocuSign.
- SOC 2 evidence and data handling attestation (we're a regulated clinical data customer).
- Pricing: the attached offer shows a 12-month commit with quarter billing; procurement will want a clear invoice path and a one-time activation invoice if applicable.

Can you confirm the path (DocuSign -> PO -> Azure marketplace entitlement -> onboarding) and an expected timeline? Also please advise who on the Redwood side will own procurement/finance coordination.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Procurement
Aurelia Therapeutics
procurement@aureliatx.com

---
Attachment stubs: Aurelia_PrivateOffer_20270302.docx (docx), Aurelia_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request + Procurement path for Azure private plan

Hi Ellen — great to hear. Short answers up front: yes, DocuSign -> PO -> Azure entitlement provisioning is our standard path; entitlement typically shows Active within 48-72 hours after marketplace purchase confirmation (shorter if we pre-provision).

Action items I'm looping in:
- Marissa (CS/onboarding) will own provisioning and onboarding timeline, including secure workspace creation and key rotation.
- Rishi (Legal) will own contract redlines and DPA/SOC2 evidence.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Rishi will review your private-offer doc and send redlines by EOD Friday (2027-03-05).
2) We can share a SOC 2 summary and our attestation link today; Rishi will confirm anything more specific needed for clinical data.
3) If procurement prefers, we can schedule a 30-min alignment call with finance (invoice routing) — propose Thurs 3/4 at 1pm PT.

I'll send a short timeline once Rishi and Marissa confirm.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com

---
Soojin's signature includes a short RedWood billing contact: finance@redwood.inference.com

From: Samir Malik <samir.malik@aureliatx.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aureliatx.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request + Procurement path for Azure private plan

Soojin / team — attaching Aurelia_Redlines_20270305.docx with our commercial and invoice routing updates. Highlights:
- We redlined the billing exhibit to require a single invoice to our central AP mailbox (ap@aureliatx.com) per quarter.
- Requested a 45-day payment term.
- Added a clause requiring a one-time activation invoice for marketplace entitlement fees so our G/L matches Azure.

We also need SOC 2 Type II report access or an AOC; the security team flagged the need for evidence that tenant isolation and key handling meet our controls.

Can Rishi confirm whether Redwood will accept our invoice routing and the 45-day term, or if finance needs a different contact?

Thanks — Samir
Procurement Ops
Aurelia Therapeutics

---
Attachment: Aurelia_Redlines_20270305.docx (docx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Malik <samir.malik@aureliatx.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request + Procurement path for Azure private plan

Hi Samir / Ellen — thanks for the redlines. Quick legal view:
- Invoice routing to ap@aureliatx.com is fine; we will need a billing contact and remit address on the PO. Please confirm the remit address and tax id for Aurelia.
- 45-day NET is acceptable to us for this deal but requires approval from finance for the private-plan onboarding; finance typically adds 5–10 days to the setup window for extended terms.
- Activation invoice: we can issue a one-time activation invoice. Please add that as a line item in the PO (code: RW-ACT-001).

On SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II AOC and a security addendum. I can attach the AOC privately once we confirm an NDA is in place; alternatively, we can provide a secure download link restricted to named contacts.

Proposed next steps:
- Ellen: please confirm remit address and PO contact (name + email).
- Samir: once we have remit and PO timeline, Marissa will confirm provisioning window (target 3–5 business days after entitlement confirmation + finance checks).
- I will prepare a short DPA addendum addressing data segregation and key management; this will be routed for signature alongside the private-offer.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---
(Brief legal footer and internal note: Rishi marks items that need finance approval.)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aureliatx.com>, Samir Malik <samir.malik@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, finance@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request + Procurement path for Azure private plan

Ellen / Samir — thanks, all items look actionable. Summary and plan:

- Remit & PO contact: Ellen to confirm by end of day 3/10.
- DocuSign: I'll send the private-offer and DPA as a combined envelope; DocuSign link will be sent to procurement@aureliatx.com and ap@aureliatx.com.
- SOC 2 AOC: Rishi will provide a secure access link once NDA is confirmed (target 3/10).
- Billing & terms: Finance confirms acceptance of NET45; finance@redwood.inference.com is CC'd to start the approval. Activation invoice will be generated on entitlement provisioning.
- Onboarding: Marissa will schedule a provisioning kickoff once DocuSign is complete — estimated completion no later than 5 business days after entitlement is active.

Please reply with your preferred time for a 30-min call if any of the above needs live alignment; otherwise we'll proceed on the timeline above.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Aurelia onboarded.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
Footer: DocuSign envelope (to be generated): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&id=abc123-aurelia-offer
